source: v28 vocabulary base + legacy duplicate cleanup + curated v29 6,000-word expansion

features.grammarDedup: Globally normalized question stems; retained one best-complete record per stem.
features.readingTranslation: Full passage translation appears only after answering the final question of a passage.
features.readingTimer: Each passage has a target reading time and a pauseable count-up stopwatch.
features.learningAnalytics: Local progress analytics show actual mistakes, level accuracy, coverage, and review-risk candidates.
features.examples: All vocabulary and idiom examples rewritten to be grammatically valid, target-specific, and translation-matched.
features.smartChoices: Same-part-of-speech distractors are prioritized; family questions use the target derivative part of speech.
features.allVocabModes: Context, synonym, and family question types are available at every vocabulary level.
features.posLabels: Vocabulary items expose normalized part-of-speech labels such as [n], [v], [adj], [adv].
features.mobileUX: Next button remains visible but disabled before answering; mobile progress reset is available.
